description: B1 scalar Caputo relaxation D^alpha u = -lambda u, u(0)=1, tau in [0,1] (T_r = tau_c); 2 x 2 design {network input: tau | (tau, tau^alpha)} x {gate of the hard initial condition: 1-exp(-beta tau) | 1-exp(-beta tau^alpha)}, forward and inverse (identification of alpha) on one common mesh

mesh.grading: tau_n = (n/N)^r, the same mesh for the forward and the inverse problem (alpha is unknown in the latter)

definitions.alpha_res: argmin over alpha of the mean squared L1 residual of the exact solution (order alpha_true) on the mesh
definitions.alpha_ls: argmin over alpha of the data misfit of the L1 time-stepper solution (piecewise-linear interpolation to the observation times): the classical least-squares estimate
definitions.alpha_joint: argmin over alpha and over all nodal values of the training objective (mean squared residual + data_weight * mean squared misfit) with a piecewise-linear trial function: what a perfect optimiser with a perfectly flexible network would return
